hooks.name: Missing English strings on save
hooks.description: tech.md quality gate: a change to content/strings/zh.json lists keys missing from en.json.

action.prompt:
content/strings/zh.json was saved. Quality gate (tech.md): run exactly this once (no pipe, so the exit code is the script's):
npm run validate -- --strings
Exit 0: en.json has every key, say so in one line. Exit 3: list the missing keys it printed (they fall back to Chinese in game; English is Claude's to write, never machine-translated). Exit 2: quote its "cannot run" message. Do not write any English yourself, do not edit content/, do not commit; report only.
